name: tyssue_2d_bm_coupled
description: R4 — explicit BM<->epithelium coupling: a 2D tyssue sheet (PlanarGeometry over the cross-section mesh) with the BM as a face energy (BMFaceAreaElasticity, tension continuous across shared vertices) resisting a grown preferred basal area. A short relax shows the confinement; the time-series growth sweep across no-bm/elastic/relaxing modes is the study's canonical run.

bm_stiffness.description: BM face-energy stiffness K_BM (0 = no BM / free control).

bm_rest_area.description: BM rest area A_rest the face energy pulls toward.

prefered_area.description: Preferred (grown) basal cell area the cell relaxes toward.

line_tension.description: Junction line tension of the 2D sheet.
